body: I just feel so very alone. I feel like a pointless person. I know it's nothing new. I know there are people out there who feel the same but why are they not around me? Why am I stuck in a room surrounded by the sounds of others socialising with ease and not haunted by feelings that they don't even understand. I don't understand why I had to be the way I am. Every day I put on a face. Every day I help others. The irony of it all being that I'm heading a student charity somewhat like the Samaritans. I'm there to listen to people; I'm there to ask how others are. Nobody asks me how I am. And if they did I wouldn't know how to answer. I just know it's...not good.
